Clark County Code, the Development Agreement with TOLL SOUTH LV LCC for a single-family residential development on 1.26 acres,

competent jurisdiction, such holding shall not invalidate the remaining parts of this ordinance.

Clark County Code in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.

together with names of the County Commissioners voting for or against its passage, in anewspap^ published in^d having a general
